Outdoor TVs in Australia are `purpose-built to withstand harsh weather, featuring IP55 or IP65 waterproofing, extreme temperature tolerances, and ultra-bright screens (1,500 to 4,000 nits) to combat glare` . Popular suppliers offer models suited for everything from shaded patios to full-sun poolside areas.[[1]](https://outdoortv.com.au/blogs/learning-hub/outdoor-tv-faqs)[[2]](https://englaon.com.au/collections/outdoor-tv)[[3]](https://www.sylvoxtv.com.au/collections/outdoor-tv)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/outdoortvsaustralia/)

Leading Outdoor TV Brands & Retailers

- **Outdoor TVs Australia:** Specializes directly in local outdoor entertainment. Popular options include the **Spark Element** (for covered areas) and the **Spark Pavilion 2** (4K QLED, 2500 nits, full sun), which starts at around $3,824 AUD for a 55-inch [Full Sun Outdoor TVs Australia](https://outdoortv.com.au/collections/full-sun?srsltid=AfmBOopiMSiwL-W5RHXJusB52RsEfvJ77GzKt44s4AA9EFvpALiIWLmW).[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/outdoortvsaustralia/)[[2]](https://outdoortv.com.au/)[[3]](https://outdoortv.com.au/collections/full-sun)[[4]](https://outdoortv.com.au/products/spark-pavilion-2-pro-outdoor-tv-86)
- **Englaon:** A highly popular brand for all-weather viewing, widely available across major hardware and tech chains [Outdoor TV - englaon au](https://englaon.com.au/collections/outdoor-tv?srsltid=AfmBOorEqmlPiIDt5VkIen3HOa4gUQG6cpzVT3bLxvvkX8_zMOkHBH3h).
- **Sylvox:** Known for its Pool Pro and Deck Pro series, bringing Google TV functionality and Dolby Atmos to outdoor spaces.

Where to Buy In-Store and Online

- **[Outdoor TVs Australia Store](https://outdoortv.com.au/?srsltid=AfmBOoo1djztU3jvCdh6t-lKHrjBqRAEF_D68iOjqqY7rNjiqfASou7J):** Direct-to-consumer online retailer offering home delivery, a "help me choose" quiz, and package deals on mounts and covers.
- **[Bunnings Warehouse](https://www.bunnings.com.au/):** Carries selected outdoor smart models like Englaon in-store and for online home delivery.
- **[Harvey Norman](https://www.harveynorman.com.au/buy/outdoor-tvs?srsltid=AfmBOooO8Gl98XLgMR_G_VmkcBhhSfCgQVjZBVSS006YZb-8g3eQ8CkI):** Stocks a large variety of waterproof and semi-outdoor smart TVs from brands like Englaon and Spark (often ranging from $2,999 to $7,999 AUD depending on screen size and brightness) Outdoor TVs - Harvey Norman.[[1]](https://www.harveynorman.com.au/buy/outdoor-tvs)[[2]](https://outdoortv.com.au/collections/full-sun)

Essential Setup Considerations

- **Brightness:** Choose a *Partial Sun* TV (under 2000 nits) for covered patios, or a *Full Sun* TV (2500+ nits) if the screen faces direct Australian sunlight.
- **Audio:** While outdoor TVs have built-in waterproof speakers, pairing them with weather-resistant outdoor soundbars or Bluetooth speakers is highly recommended for optimal sound quality.
- **Mounting & Covers:** Ensure you use rust-proof, heavy-duty outdoor mounts and keep the TV covered when not in use to protect against debris, insects, and harsh UV rays.[[1]](https://mrantenna.com.au/articles/australia-day-outdoor-tv-setup/)[[2]](https://luxiliving.com.au/products/outdoor-tvgoogle-tv-2000-nits)[[3]](https://www.octopustvenclosures.com.au/blogs/blog/what-is-the-best-way-to-mount-an-enclosed-outdoor-tv)[[4]](https://englaon.com.au/collections/outdoor-tv)[[5]](https://tvcovers.com.au/)
